name: Date picker
description: Date picker 360 wide on surface container high, with 28 corners: header (title, headline and the button that switches the mode), the month with arrows (single) or the month subtitle (range), the weekdays and the 48 day grid with the chosen day in primary (single) or the range in secondary container with the ends in primary (range). The grid is that of the month given by `month` and `year` (4, 5 or 6 rows, leap years included); without both, a 31-day month that starts on a Wednesday. Today (`today`) gets a 1 outline and the number in primary, unless it is the chosen day.
